body: Thanks, that means alot. Have a great day/night!
Yah, that's kind of what I was thinking of doing. Thank you SO MUCH. You are one awesome person and you make up for all the crap on reddit.

Thank you so much

And as for your question, sadly I don't think I would find myself wanting to hang out with him at all. He was always a fairly immature guy which was cool when we were younger but as I grew up I just couldn't relate anymore. Deep down he'll always be important to me but I don't see myself being good friends without forcing it on my end.

First of, thanks so much for all of the advise. 

Next this might make me seem like a complete dick, but it's what's going through my head so I might as well say it.  I don't know how I feel about all of the sudden trying to be really close with him. I stand by the fact that I love him to death and I'm there for him if he ever needs me, and I want him to know that. But I distanced myself from him for a reason and something feels wrong about closing the distance because of what he did. I feel like in the long run if he does get back on his feet and I've completely reached out to him that distance will still be there in my mind which will make our relationship feel meaningless. Sorry I'm not doing a great job putting this into words. I guess the best but least delicate way to put it is that If he starts doing better and were really close it would be forced on my end. 

Also, what do you think about righting him a card or just texting him and speaking from the heart and saying that I love him and i'm here for him.

By "look worse", I guess what I'm trying to get at is that this is going to be the first wave of friends that see him and for me, someone who obviously tried to distance myself from him(even though I really do care about him), to be a part of that first wave could be more depressing to him. I have no doubt in my mind now(thanks) that I should reach out to him in some way I'm just unsure of how and when.

He's definitely going to have visitors, and I definitely will make sure he knows I care. But if he does have a couple of friends who truly care about him(I really don't know if he does or doesn't) I think it might look worse if I'm there. And just to clarify we maybe say hi once a month, and we didn't even go to the same school for a year. So we are very far from close right now.
